Noah: TerraWorks PM ping - they want us to accept compacted hourly backfills up to 4 days and automatically apply entitlements/credits. Need policy + quick eng ask: idempotency and proof fields.

Partner Bot: uploaded schema & sample. snippet: ```{ "partner":"terraworks","device":"TW-42","batch_ref":"bw-20260319-18","units":320,"proof_hash":"sha256:abc" }```

Ivy: finance prefers 24h auto-credit, ingest up to 7d for visibility. we can offer 72h auto-credit for partners that provide signed proof + monotonic batch_ref.

Erin: eng notes: require signed JWT or HMAC, persist unique key on (partner,batch_ref,proof_hash), and tombstone endpoint for voids within 7d. consider feature-flagged pilot for extended window.

Sam: support/UI: Console needs "batch_ref", "proof_hash", "signed_at", and "ledger_state". create KB: "Backfilled usage & entitlements".

Ivy: proposed response to TerraWorks: default policy = 24h auto-credit; ingest visibility to 7d; pilot: 72h auto-credit if you provide signed manifests + monotonic batch_ref + replay SLA. Need commit by EOD.

CI Bot: queued replay-tester job on partner bundle s3://terraworks/tests/compact-backfill-20260321.tar.gz (#TW-3001). ETA ~90m.

Noah: owners: Erin (eng) implement idempotency + signature verification, Ivy (finance) finalize pilot caps, Sam (support) KB + Console, Noah (partnerships) to negotiate. I'll reply to partner with the hybrid offer pending test results.
